sentence: This project builds a cross-campus curriculum that teaches cybersecurity skills and teamwork for working together in remote settings.
This project studies how floods and other extreme events harm smaller communities and builds models that help them plan for adaptation.
This project studies how mechanical forces shape tissue and uses robotic tools and computer models to guide how tissues fold.
This project builds a theory of tensor ranks and uses it to attack open questions in math and computer science.
This project studies how software supply chain threats affect high-performance computing and tests how current security tools can handle them.
This project explores how generative models can compress the measurements from satellite lidar that scans the Earth.
This project builds open-source software that analyzes hypergraphs, which describe interactions among more than two entities at once.
This project designs and tests payloads for targeted cancer therapies that destroy cancer cells resistant to current treatments.
This project improves an instrument that measures the mass of individual particles of frozen precipitation and tests it in the laboratory and the field.
This project tests whether nanoparticles of similar size and shape are taken up by cells better and deliver therapeutic drugs more effectively.
This project builds a framework using machine intelligence that balances user privacy, security and usefulness of collected data.
This project studies how bacteria swim upstream against fluid flows and how they move through flow networks.
This project builds models and computer tools to study how chromatin is organized in single cells using large but sparse datasets.
This project studies how the geometry and permeability of bacterial microcompartments affect how bacteria carry out chemical reactions.
This project asks whether heart cells use electrical signals to detect misplaced DNA and RNA and how this affects their immune defense.
